en: Be careful out in the desert, $c.
The mage tower to the north.
We now hold the wisdom of the Winterax, $n. This power can be yours for a short time should you so desire.
Goodbye, cruel world... I'm leavin' you today... goodbye... goodbye... goodbye...
Known throughout the lands, Antonio Perelli's goods now for sale near Sentinel Hill! I must move on soon, so make haste.
Let Marshal Windsor know that I am ready.
<Lydros reaches into his robe and presents you with a dull, flat elven blade.>$B$BIn ages past, well before even the War of the Ancients, there existed this blade.
Soldiers of Frostwolf, come to my aid! The time has come to unleash the fury of the elements upon them!
Who is this mere $r that meddles with that which is past?  May the legend of Stalvan die along with you!

We need a great number of copper bars, $c. The upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to use up a lot of metal for weapons, armor and whatnot. I'm told that the Horde alone needs to collect $1998w copper bars. As of now we have $2018w.
I am proud. You are truly a gifted student. Now, for your final lesson...
The race will start in 1 minute!
You have reached new heights in your path to mastery. Let us see if we can take you even further...
There is a large tent on the east side of Bloodhoof Village.  You will find Narm Skychaser awaiting you there.

Unpleasant place, this "Undercity". Not at all like the Lordaeron of old. How I miss it...$b$bIf you're looking to go to Stratholme, I'm afraid I'm unable to assist at the moment. The towers nearby the burning city are still in contention, and as such my powers are far too weak to aid you. Return to me once you're victorious there.
The Frostwolf Relief Hut is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
Yeah, no problem, $n! Sorry... thought you were done with it already.
This evil cannot be allowed to enter this world!  Come my children!

Any chance to fight against the Horde, especially orcs, is a good time if you ask me. You'll find plenty of battle in Warsong Gulch, that you will. Head on over to the Hall of Arms and speak with Lylandris. She'll set you on your way.
Bears??
When will they learn?
I fear we may never soothe them...
It's the big building in Razor Hill that's not the barracks.  Just talk to Innkeeper Grosk inside.  Got that?
Be alert, you lazy mules!
I raise my brew and hope to be rid of the likes of you!  Cheers, you no good scoundrel, $n!
It is true I have skills to teach to those who are worthy. Would that be you?
Let me give you my regards for Greatfather Winter, scum...
If you think I'm good, you should see my husband fight.
I would have just dropped some Evershine in my tank and been back home before they realized I'd gone!
You can find Radnaal practicing his craft outside his home on the road to Darnassus.  You should stop by and see what he can teach you.
That is terrible.
Hail, what ya want?
Unless?
You have come to play? Then let us play!

That's right, um, $g lad : lass;, all of the war materiel is being transported to Silithus and the last of it should get there within $2113w days. After that, we'll all just have to wait and see who puts forth a $g hero : heroine; to reconstitute the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais. Only when that occurs will the war begin to open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Mudskunks are a particularly smelly breed of fish that likes tropical waters.  The Zulian Mudskunk - the smelliest of them all, can only be found in the steamy waters of Zul'Gurub.$B$BThe Zulian Mudskunks are what I believe attracted Gahz'ranka to the place, though trolls will probably tell you he's one of their gods...$B$BBelieve what you like, but mark me - fill one of my lures with Zulian Mudskunks and that old boy will come, for sure!
Intruders!  Slay them!  Don't let them into the room!
As you wish, $c.
Tis a good day to live, neh? Hard work and good food-- there are worse things we could be doing on such a beautiful day.
Where is Elder Brightspear?
I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.
You think you're smart enough? You think you got what it takes? Let's find out!

Look at these samples! What does it mean? What does it mean? I'm going to need time, time to look at all this information. And I'll need more information. Information I can't get... damn! Think, Laris, think!$B$BWhat are you going to do? What?!$B$BThere has to be a solution!
Help! I've only one hand to defend myself with.
My watch is eternal, mortal.
I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.
Most people around these parts frown on lockpicking. As a little professional courtesy, let me show you a few tricks I've learned.

Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.
%s arming. T-minus 60 seconds.
My leg feels much better now, the remedy must be working. If you will excuse me, I must go report to my superiors about what has transpired here.
The flags are now placed at their bases.
Let's have just a small taste...
%s squeezes the last bit of life out of $n and swallows their soul.
I will serve the master... in death!
Be on your guard!
Glacial Wrists.
My Lord. From Father Lankester.
